formulas.meaning: Curved surface area uses slant height because it measures the lateral surface. Volume uses perpendicular height because it measures stacked cross-sections. Total area of a closed cone includes its circular base once. Confusing the two heights is a common source of correct-looking wrong answers.
formulas.restriction: Right circular cone with positive radius/height; all lengths use one unit.

misconceptions.mistake: Replace h by l in the volume formula.
